jobs.meta_description: Build your future with Carus Ferry Ab Ltd as a Team Leader - Platform Operations in Maarianhamina. Learn more about the role and apply now.
jobs.description: Carus Ferry Ab Ltd is seeking a Team Leader – Platform Operations & Automation to lead and develop our POA team. This role combines hands-on technical work, operational ownership, and team leadership. You will spend approximately 70% of your time working hands-on with infrastructure, automation, and operations, and 30% leading and developing your team. This is not a pure management role—you will work alongside your team, solving technical problems, building automation, and maintaining critical systems. You will mentor and guide team members, ensure knowledge sharing, and support their development.
what_we_expect: Experience in hands-on infrastructure, operations, or platform roles (you are comfortable doing the work, not just managing it).
Strong technical background in infrastructure, automation, and CI/CD.
Experience leading or coordinating teams in platform, operations, or infrastructure-focused environments.
Experience with technologies such as Ansible, Bash, IBM Cloud, Linux, CI/CD tooling, Oracle, MongoDB, monitoring and security tools.
Understanding of managed service operations, operational reliability, and security considerations.
Strong collaboration skills and experience working closely with development and architecture functions.
job_responsibilities: Own and ensure stable, secure, and reliable operations in production environments.
Monitor systems, handle incidents, and ensure uptime, performance, and operational stability.
Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure, environments, and CI/CD pipelines.
Drive standardization and automation to improve efficiency and reduce operational risk.
Troubleshoot and resolve operational issues and contribute directly to deployment and platform improvements.
Own and evolve Carus automation platform.
what_we_offer: Competitive salary.
Opportunity to shape and evolve Carus operational and automation capabilities.
A culture built on trust, clarity, and practical problem-solving.
Flexible working conditions with hybrid possibilities.
A role where your technical expertise is valued and you work with a high degree of ownership and independence.

jobs.description: A 51-year-old family woman with Multiple Sclerosis, fluent in Finnish, is seeking a personal assistant for herself. Education or experience in the field is not required, but a background in nursing is considered advantageous. Applicants from diverse language and cultural backgrounds are encouraged to apply. The work duties include supporting the assisted person in various activities, such as work, chores, and leisure.

jobs.meta_description: Looking for a Northern Lights Tour Guide/Photographer job in Rovaniemi? Lapland X Tours Oy, Rovaniemi is seeking motivated candidates—apply today.
jobs.description: Lapland X Tours, a premium, small-group tour company in Rovaniemi with a 5.0 rating across Google Maps and TripAdvisor, is seeking an Aurora Tour Guide/Photographer to work directly with the founder, take on real responsibility, and grow with the company. what_we_expect: Fluent English (other languages a big plus).
Category B driving licence and confidence driving on snow and ice.

A social, friendly personality — someone guests remember.
Genuine knowledge of and passion for Lapland's nature, history, and culture.
Reliable, independent, and eager to learn and grow.
job_responsibilities: Guide Northern Lights tours, plus day tours and VIP experiences.
Take great aurora and landscape photos for our guests using professional cameras.
Represent Lapland X Tours and the 5.0 reputation we've earned.
Share the authentic side of Lapland — its history, culture, and way of life.
Drive our tour van safely in Arctic winter conditions.
Deliver warm, personal, 5-star service to VIP guests and travellers alike.
what_we_offer: €16/hour, plus overtime and other supplements according to the collective agreement (TES).
Direct mentorship from the founder and a real path to a permanent job.
Real responsibility in a small, ambitious, high-quality company.
Unforgettable work in one of the best places on earth for it.

We value diversity and support personal and professional development, offering a collaborative workspace where you can thrive alongside colleagues from over 20 different nationalities.

jobs.title: Electrical Commissioning Specialist
jobs.salary_range: Competitive hourly wage based on Finnish collective agreements.
jobs.meta_description: Start your next career step as a Electrical Commissioning Specialist at Academic Work Finland Oy. Great opportunity in Helsinki—apply now.
jobs.description: We are looking for an Electrical Commissioning Specialist at Academic Work Finland Oy in Helsinki, Vantaa, Kerava, and surrounding areas. This role involves commissioning electrical systems within L0-L6 levels, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, and ensuring the safe and controlled commissioning of data centers. The ideal candidate has a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field and extensive experience in testing, commissioning, or maintenance of complex electrical systems. They must be fluent in English, have expertise in critical power distribution and protection principles, and be able to evaluate technical documentation and resolve issues independently.
what_we_expect: Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, several years of hands-on experience in testing, commissioning, or maintaining complex electrical systems.

Experience in data centers or other mission-critical environments, such as power plants, hospitals, or industrial facilities, and a proven track record in managing test programs, cross-disciplinary interfaces, and technical problem-solving under pressure.
Deep expertise in critical power distribution, protection principles, and the complete L0–L6 commissioning lifecycle, including BAS/EPMS interfaces and integrated system testing logic.
Analytical, highly organized, fluent in English, strong ability to evaluate technical documentation, perform root-cause analysis on test deviations, and independently drive issue resolution.
Willingness to work on-site around Finland, handle non-standard working hours when needed, and start on short notice in an international project environment.
job_responsibilities: Reviewing and developing commissioning plans, responsibility matrixes, test programs, test scripts and acceptance criteria.
Assessing the commissioning readiness of equipment and systems prior to the start of testing phases.
Participating in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), evaluating results, and documenting findings.
Providing technical support for L2-level equipment and installation inspections, as well as L3-level start-up and functional tests.
Planning, monitoring, verifying results for L4-level system and functional tests.
Supporting the planning and execution of the L5 Integrated System Test (IST) phase and verifying inter-system functionality.
what_we_offer: A key role in the safe and controlled commissioning of a technically demanding data center.
An opportunity to work with critical electrical systems and integrated testing in an international environment.
A vantage point at the interface of the client, commissioning organization, designers, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
Support from Granlund's extensive expertise in data centers, electrical systems, automation, and project management.
Continuous recruitment process with two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test to find the right talent for the right position.
jobs.search_keywords: Electrical Commissioning Specialist, Granlund Oy, Finland

jobs.title: People & Culture Generalist
jobs.salary_range: The salary for the position starts at 3099 €/month and will be specified during the recruitment process
jobs.meta_description: Looking for a People & Culture Generalist job in Tampere? Ikea Oy, Tampere is seeking motivated candidates—apply today.
jobs.description: IKEA Oy, Tampere is seeking a People & Culture Generalist to join our team. As a Unit P&C Generalist, you will be a trusted HR partner, supporting leaders and co-workers in thriving, creating a healthy and inclusive workplace, and turning People & Culture plans into practical everyday actions. With several years of broad HR experience and expertise in work ability management, you will work closely with occupational health partners and use wellbeing insights to support sustainable working life. You will partner with leaders to plan, deliver, and follow up local People & Culture actions, providing practical HR advice and coaching, coordinating work ability management, and supporting leaders in developing their leadership capabilities.
what_we_expect: Several years of broad HR experience and can provide practical, trusted support to leaders, co-workers, and the business.
Expertise in work ability management and a relevant educational background in education, psychology, or a related field, supported by hands-on experience.
Understanding of collective agreements and employment relations, ideally the Finnish Commerce Collective Agreement or another collective agreement applied in your work.
Knowledge of how to work closely with occupational health partners and use wellbeing insights to support sustainable everyday working life.
Build trust through approachable, clear, and confidential communication, and document and explain HR matters accurately to different audiences.
Take responsibility for moving agreed actions forward, stay calm when priorities change, and work independently while actively asking for and offering support.
job_responsibilities: Partner with unit leaders to plan, deliver, and follow up local People & Culture actions that support business priorities and a positive co-worker experience.
Provide practical HR advice and coaching to leaders and co-workers on employment relations, policies, procedures, and everyday people matters.
Coordinate work ability management and occupational health collaboration, helping to find timely, respectful, and sustainable solutions for co-workers.

Support leaders in developing their leadership capabilities and help co-workers build the skills needed today and tomorrow also executing trainings and on-boarding process for co-workers and managers.
Contribute to fair and constructive cooperation with employee representatives and ensure that local practices follow applicable collective agreements, legislation, and IKEA ways of working.
Execute operational people-related tasks and daily routines on unit level, e.g., on- and offboarding related tasks.
what_we_offer: Salary starting at 3099 €/month and will be specified during the recruitment process based on the selected candidates' experience, skills, and the final content of the role.

A wide range of comprehensive staff benefits, including flexible Epassi saldo, staff discounts on IKEA products, healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch menus at very low prices in our staff restaurants, One IKEA Bonus, gifts on special days and at Christmas, and much more.
You take responsibility for moving agreed actions forward, stay calm when priorities change and work independently while actively asking for and offering support.
jobs.search_keywords: People & Culture Generalist, People & Culture, HR, People & Culture Manager, People & Culture Specialist, People & Culture Generalist

jobs.salary_range: salary and good employee benefits
jobs.meta_description: Join Lokki Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy as a Scrum Master and grow your career in Kuopio. Check details and apply now.
jobs.description: We are looking for a Scrum Master to join our client in the banking industry. The Scrum Master will lead Agile ceremonies, coach the team, and drive the successful delivery of strategic initiatives. This role combines Agile leadership, project execution, stakeholder management, and AI enablement. The ideal candidate has experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, Project Manager, or Execution Leader in a technology-driven environment. They should have strong delivery leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-team coordination skills, as well as a good understanding of API-based architectures, cloud technologies, and modern software development practices.
what_we_expect: Experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, Project Manager, or Execution Leader in a technology-driven environment.
Strong delivery leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-team coordination capabilities.
Good understanding of API-based architectures, cloud technologies, infrastructure concepts, DevOps, and modern software development practices.
Understanding of Open Banking, digital platforms, or financial services technology ecosystems is considered a strong advantage.
Ability to engage effectively with architects, engineers, and business stakeholders without requiring hands-on technical expertise.
Proven interest in AI-driven ways of working and the ability to identify and drive adoption of AI, automation, and productivity-enhancing solutions across teams.
job_responsibilities: Facilitate and continuously improve Agile ways of working within the team, ensuring effective execution of Scrum and SAFe practices.
Organize and lead sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, reviews, backlog refinement sessions, PI Planning, and other Agile ceremonies.
Coach team members, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile principles, continuous improvement, flow optimization, and value-driven delivery.
Foster a high-performing, self-organizing, cross-functional team culture with strong collaboration, accountability, transparency, and psychological safety.
Monitor and improve team health, engagement, predictability, quality, and delivery performance.
what_we_offer: Versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting.
Competitive salary and good employee benefits.
